card.name: Linking words in drug interaction text
card.fires_on: Short joining words or word starts in drug-interaction and pharmacology passages, such as "to" after "bind" before a receptor, or "co" before "agulation" or "administration".

modes.label: "to" after bind
modes.description: The word "to" after "bind" just before a receptor name.
modes.example: Concomitant use of VYVGART with medications that bind<< to>> the human neonatal Fc receptor (

modes.label: Start of a medical word
modes.description: A short opening piece of a longer medical word, like co- or hyp-, within interaction or effect text.
modes.example: Altered<< co>>agulation parameters and/or bleeding, including

modes.label: Commas in animal lists
modes.description: A comma between animal names in a list of small mammals.
modes.example: including rabbits, guinea pigs<<,>> hamsters, and gerbils.
